answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 28172 Country: India Title: If a woman breastfeed a girl in the odd situation, so in the future could she marry the girl with her son? Question: If a woman breastfeed a girl in the odd situation, so in the future could she marry the girl with her son? Answer ID: 28172 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 87/85/B=1432) They became foster-brother and sister. They cannot marry each other. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
